claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ac_set_base (second ability modifier)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing modify_ac_set_base shape carries exactly one abilityMod field, encoding formulas like Mage Armor (13 + Dex) and Robe of the Archmagi. Monk Unarmored Defense requires 10 + Dex + Wis — two distinct ability modifiers summed into the base AC formula. No other existing atom or composition honestly expresses this: splitting it into a set_base (one mod) plus an additive modify_ac (second mod) would produce the same number but misrepresent the rule as a set-then-add operation rather than a single base-AC formula. A second optional ability modifier field on ModifyAcSetBaseEffect would cover both the single-mod family (Mage Armor, Robe) and the dual-mod family (Monk, Barbarian Unarmored Defense).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers
